title: After Choosing the Elite Track
description:
Three months since you stepped into the elite track.
It was a narrow door, but you got through.
Today there was a gathering of people on the same track.

choices.result_text:
You mingled.
The way they spoke and carried themselves was different.

You watched.
How they talked, what they valued.

title: After Choosing the Network Ascent Track
description:
Three months into the network-building track.
Connections had been piling up.
Today one of those connections brought an unexpected opportunity.

choices.result_text:
You took it.
The network track had started delivering.

choices.text: Hold out for a better opportunity through a higher-level contact
choices.result_text: You waited.

title: After Choosing the Social Entrepreneur Track
description:
Three months into the social entrepreneurship track.
It was a direction that put meaning before money.
Today that direction came back as a small result.

choices.result_text:
You took it as meaningful.
The revenue was small.

choices.text: Wonder again if this is the right direction
choices.result_text:
You wondered again.
Can meaning and survival happen at the same time?

title: After Fully Trusting Jaehyuk
description:
Two months since you put your full trust in Jaehyuk and shared everything.
The relationship had shifted since then.
Today you saw how Jaehyuk responded to that trust.

choices.result_text:
Jaehyuk had kept the trust.
Someone who fully honors complete trust — they're rare.

Jaehyuk had been using that trust for his own gain.
Giving everything — had meant losing everything.

title: After Standing Up to Jaehyuk
description:
Two months since you confronted Jaehyuk directly.
The relationship had gone cold.
Today Jaehyuk reached out first.

choices.result_text:
You picked up.
Jaehyuk said, "I'm actually glad you said it to my face."

You didn't pick up.
Standing up to him had also meant closing this chapter.

title: The Front Wheel Left Bent
description:
The bicycle parked outside the goshiwon still had a bent front wheel.
The repair shop's 80,000 won estimate had not changed either.

The 80,000 won in cash from the crash was still in {name}'s wallet.

choices.text: Pay 80,000 won and repair the front wheel
choices.result_text:
{name} wheeled the bicycle he had left unrepaired back to the shop.
He paid 80,000 won, and the mechanic replaced the bent front wheel.

On the way back, the bicycle no longer pulled to one side.

choices.text: Leave the bicycle and use public transit
choices.result_text:
{name} left the bent bicycle parked outside the goshiwon.
He kept the 80,000 won in his wallet.

That day too, he walked to the bus stop and tapped his transit card to board.

title: After Choosing Daeun
description:
Two months since you gave something up to choose Daeun.
That choice had changed the relationship.
Today Daeun brought up that choice.

choices.text: Say it was the right call
choices.result_text:
You said it was.
Daeun asked, "Was it hard back then?"

You said it was complicated.
Daeun nodded.

title: After Making a Real Commitment to Daeun
description:
Two months since you decided to stay by Daeun's side.
Small promises had piled up.
Today, without thinking, Daeun used the word "we."

choices.result_text:
You took it in stride.
"We" — it means more when the other person says it first.

You held onto it.
Small promises, and then "we."

title: After Stealing from the Café and Gambling It
description:
Two months since you stole from the café and gambled the money.
It hadn't gone well.
Today something brought that incident back to mind.

choices.text: Tell yourself you'll never do that again
choices.result_text:
You told yourself never again.
Stealing and then gambling — what followed had taught you something.

choices.text: Write it off as the past
choices.result_text:
You wrote it off.
But the past — is what made you who you are now.

title: After Stealing from the Café and Investing It
description:
Two months since you invested the money you took from the café.
It had turned a profit.
Today the guilt surfaced again.

choices.text: Find some way to give it back
choices.result_text:
You looked for a way to return it.
Anonymously if needed.

choices.text: Cover it over with the gains
choices.result_text:
You buried it under the profits.
But covering something over doesn't make it disappear.

title: After Using the Café Incident as a Stepping Stone
description:
Two months since you used the café situation to open a new opportunity.
It had been an unexpected path.
Today you looked back at how that opportunity had unfolded.

choices.result_text:
You kept at it.
It started as a muddy beginning — but what mattered in the end was following through.

choices.text: Admit the path now is different from how it began
choices.result_text: You admitted it was different.

title: After Making Up for the Café Incident
description:
Two months since you made a mistake at the café and tried to make amends.
You hadn't known how things had settled.
Today someone connected to the café reached out.

choices.result_text:
You picked up.
The other person knew you'd tried to make amends.

You answered despite the discomfort.
Making amends doesn't erase the guilt.

title: After Being Humiliated at the Café
description:
Two months since you were publicly humiliated at the café.
The memory was still with you.
Today you found yourself in a similar situation again.

choices.result_text:
You handled it differently.
The humiliation back then had changed how you judged things now.

You made the same mistake again.
Experience doesn't automatically become a lesson.

title: After Leaving the Café Early
description:
Two months since you quit the café job ahead of schedule.
There had been various reasons.
Today you ran into someone who used to work there with you.

choices.result_text:
You greeted them warmly.
They were glad to see you too.
Even if you left early — you shared time there.

You walked past awkwardly.
Leaving early was still sitting with you.
